why: a bullet naming the case, a task and the owner is the one shape the arm accepts
a bullet that denies the deferral and the approval is not an approval
a bullet inside an HTML comment is not rendered, so it is not on the record
a bullet that names two cases must not give both the one approval
a prefix of a case id is not that case
a case no bullet names has no deferral
a path-shaped id names no case
